verdict.rationale: Moneybird ships its own MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client to the same REST API, so an agent can pull live administration data. The evidence only documents contact endpoints, though, and does not show ledger, balance, cash-position or financial-report data reaching the agent, or that an affordability answer is grounded in it. Missing for 10: documented ledger/balance/report endpoints or MCP tools, evidence of an agent answering affordability questions from live financial data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API

citations.quote: Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
